verses.text: After Moses, the LORD's servant, died, the LORD spoke to Joshua son of Nun, who had served as Moses' assistant.
“My servant Moses is dead. Now get up and cross the Jordan with all these people into the land I'm giving the Israelites.
I've given you every place your feet will touch, just as I told Moses.
Your territory will stretch from the wilderness and Lebanon to the great Euphrates River, across all the Hittite country and west to the great sea, where the sun goes down.
Nobody will be able to stand against you as long as you live. I'll be with you just as I was with Moses. I won't fail you or abandon you.
Be strong and brave. You'll lead these people into the land I swore to give their ancestors as an inheritance.
Be strong and very brave. Make sure you live by every part of the law my servant Moses gave you. Don't turn away from it to the right or to the left, so things will go well wherever you go.
Keep the words of this book of the law on your lips. Think about them day and night, so you'll carefully do everything written in it. Then you'll prosper on your way and succeed.
Haven't I told you to be strong and brave? Don't be afraid or lose heart. The LORD your God is with you wherever you go.”
Then Joshua gave orders to the people's officers.
“Go through the camp and tell everyone, ‘Get your food ready. Within three days you'll cross the Jordan and take possession of the land the LORD your God is giving you.’”
Joshua spoke to the tribes of Reuben and Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh.
“Remember what Moses, the LORD's servant, told you: ‘The LORD your God is giving you rest and will give you this land.

Your wives, your children, and your livestock will stay in the land Moses gave you on this side of the Jordan. But all your brave fighting men are to cross over armed ahead of your fellow Israelites and help them

until the LORD gives them rest, just as he gave you rest, and they take possession of the land the LORD your God is giving them. Then you can go back and settle in your own land, the land Moses, the LORD's servant, gave you east of the Jordan.’”
They answered Joshua, “We'll do everything you've commanded us, and we'll go wherever you send us.
We'll listen to you in everything, just as we listened to Moses. May the LORD your God be with you as he was with Moses.
Anyone who rebels against your orders and refuses to listen to what you command will be put to death. Just be strong and brave.”
